<style>
:root {
  --project-blue: #003262;
  --project-gold: #FDB515;
  --project-ink: #22384d;
  --project-muted: #647487;
  --project-border: #dfe7ef;
}

.projects-intro {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 34px 36px;
  margin: 8px 0 28px;
  border: 1px solid #d8e5f2;
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f8fbff 0%, #edf5ff 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 50, 98, 0.08);
}

.projects-intro::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  right: -80px;
  bottom: -105px;
  width: 250px;
  height: 250px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(253, 181, 21, 0.18);
}

.projects-eyebrow {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  color: #906500;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.projects-intro h2 {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: 720px;
  margin: 0 0 11px;
  color: var(--project-blue);
  font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 4vw, 2.45rem);
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: -0.035em;
  line-height: 1.15;
}

.projects-intro p {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  max-width: 760px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--project-ink);
  font-size: 1.03rem;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.project-stats {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-top: 21px;
}

.project-stat {
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0, 50, 98, 0.13);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  color: var(--project-blue);
  font-size: 0.84rem;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.project-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 46px;
}

.project-card {
  --card-accent: #2674c8;
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  min-height: 330px;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 25px 25px 23px;
  border: 1px solid var(--project-border);
  border-radius: 19px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 50, 98, 0.055);
  transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.22s ease, border-color 0.22s ease;
}

.project-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  left: 0;
  height: 5px;
  background: var(--card-accent);
}

.project-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-4px);
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 35%, white);
  box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(0, 50, 98, 0.11);
}

.project-card.ml { --card-accent: #2674c8; }
.project-card.nlp { --card-accent: #7656a8; }
.project-card.game { --card-accent: #d9822b; }
.project-card.simulation { --card-accent: #16846a; }
.project-card.language { --card-accent: #bd4775; }
.project-card.world { --card-accent: #64748b; }

.project-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 13px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.project-icon {
  display: flex;
  width: 49px;
  height: 49px;
  flex: 0 0 49px;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--card-accent) 12%, white);
  font-size: 1.55rem;
}

.project-type {
  color: var(--card-accent);
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 850;
  letter-spacing: 0.075em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.project-card h2 {
  margin: 0 0 9px;
  color: var(--project-blue);
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  font-weight: 820;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.project-copy {
  flex-grow: 1;
  margin: 0 0 18px;
  color: var(--project-muted);
  line-height: 1.65;
}

.project-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 7px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.project-tags span {
  padding: 5px 9px;
  border: 1px solid #e3e9ef;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #f7f9fb;
  color: #42556a;
  font-size: 0.76rem;
  font-weight: 680;
}

.project-actions {
  margin-top: auto;
}

.project-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-radius: 11px;
  background: var(--project-blue);
  color: white !important;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 760;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
}

.project-link:hover {
  background: #0a4f8f;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

@media (max-width: 850px) {
  .project-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  .project-card {
    min-height: 0;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 520px) {
  .projects-intro {
    padding: 27px 21px;
  }

  .project-card {
    padding: 23px 19px 20px;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="projects-intro">
<div class="projects-eyebrow">Selected Technical Work</div>
<h2>From predictive models to interactive software systems.</h2>
<p>A collection of projects spanning machine learning, natural language processing, algorithms, simulation, and software engineering. Each brief explains the problem, implementation, and technical decisions behind the result.</p>

<div class="project-grid">

<article class="project-card ml">
<div class="project-head"><div class="project-icon">🏠</div><div class="project-type">Predictive Modeling</div></div>
<h2>House Price Predictor</h2>
<p class="project-copy">A supervised-learning project that predicts residential prices through regression modeling, exploratory analysis, and thoughtful feature engineering.</p>
<div class="project-tags"><span>Python</span><span>Regression</span><span>Feature Engineering</span></div>

<article class="project-card nlp">
<div class="project-head"><div class="project-icon">✉️</div><div class="project-type">Natural Language Processing</div></div>
<h2>Ham &amp; Spam Email Classifier</h2>
<p class="project-copy">A text-classification pipeline that distinguishes spam from legitimate email using language features and logistic regression.</p>
<div class="project-tags"><span>Python</span><span>NLP</span><span>Logistic Regression</span></div>
<div class="project-actions"><a class="project-link" href="Spam_and_Ham_Email_Classifier.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View project brief <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right"></i></a></div>
</article>

<article class="project-card game">
<div class="project-head"><div class="project-icon">🎮</div><div class="project-type">Software Engineering</div></div>
<h2>2048 Game</h2>
<p class="project-copy">A complete implementation of the classic puzzle game, including tile movement, merge rules, game-state transitions, and win detection.</p>
<div class="project-tags"><span>Java</span><span>Object-Oriented Design</span><span>Game Logic</span></div>
<div class="project-actions"><a class="project-link" href="2048.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View project brief <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right"></i></a></div>
</article>

<article class="project-card simulation">
<div class="project-head"><div class="project-icon">💧</div><div class="project-type">Algorithms &amp; Simulation</div></div>
<h2>Percolation Simulation</h2>
<p class="project-copy">A computational model of percolation thresholds that uses union-find structures and repeated simulation to study connectivity in porous systems.</p>
<div class="project-tags"><span>Java</span><span>Union-Find</span><span>Monte Carlo</span></div>
<div class="project-actions"><a class="project-link" href="Percolation.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View project brief <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right"></i></a></div>
</article>

<article class="project-card language">
<div class="project-head"><div class="project-icon">🌐</div><div class="project-type">Data Structures</div></div>
<h2>NGordnet Language Explorer</h2>
<p class="project-copy">An interactive system for exploring word frequencies, semantic relationships, and hierarchical connections using historical language data and WordNet.</p>
<div class="project-tags"><span>Java</span><span>Graphs</span><span>WordNet</span></div>
<div class="project-actions"><a class="project-link" href="NGordnet__Wordnet_.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View project brief <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right"></i></a></div>
</article>

<article class="project-card world">
<div class="project-head"><div class="project-icon">🗺️</div><div class="project-type">Procedural Systems</div></div>
<h2>Build Your Own World</h2>
<p class="project-copy">A tile-based game engine featuring procedurally generated environments, avatar navigation, deterministic world creation, and save/load persistence.</p>
<div class="project-tags"><span>Java</span><span>Procedural Generation</span><span>Persistence</span></div>
<div class="project-actions"><a class="project-link" href="BYOW.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View project brief <i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right"></i></a></div>
